ayuda.ayuda_rrhh_portada_introduccion: This page brings together cases in progress, job pools and offers to SAE according to your access rights.
ayuda.ayuda_rrhh_portada_paso_expedientes: Review the counts and select ‘View cases’ to open the filtered dashboard. In ‘Recent cases’, open a case number.
ayuda.ayuda_rrhh_portada_paso_nueva: To start a request, select ‘New request’ if available. Complete the form and review it before recording it.
ayuda.ayuda_rrhh_portada_paso_bolsas: Open ‘Job pools’ to view the pools and their validity periods. ‘View job pools’ opens the job pool dashboard.
ayuda.ayuda_rrhh_portada_paso_sae: ‘SAE job offers’ shows that an authorised data source is missing. Its cases button stays disabled.
ayuda.ayuda_rrhh_portada_pregunta_acceso: Why can't I see a case or job pool?
ayuda.ayuda_rrhh_portada_respuesta_acceso: The recent list shows up to eight cases; use ‘View all’ to search. The system only shows authorised data.
ayuda.ayuda_rrhh_portada_pregunta_error: What should I do if a count does not load?
ayuda.ayuda_rrhh_portada_respuesta_error: Open the relevant dashboard. If it still does not respond, try again later or contact IT support.
ayuda.ayuda_rrhh_portada_pregunta_efectos: Does opening this page or Help record any actions?
ayuda.ayuda_rrhh_portada_respuesta_efectos: No. Viewing this page or Help does not record any administrative action.
ayuda.ayuda_rrhh_portada_transcripcion: The Human Resources home page shows cases in progress, job pools and offers to SAE according to your access rights. Review the counts and open ‘View cases’ or a recent case number. Use ‘New request’, if available, to prepare a request and review it before recording it. Under ‘Job pools’ you can view pools and open their dashboard. Offers to SAE do not yet have an authorised data source. The recent list shows up to eight cases; ‘View all’ opens the full search. If a count does not load, open its dashboard or contact IT support. Opening Help does not record any action.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_002: A short walkthrough of the secure process based on a staffing need.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_003: Why are no names or documents shown?
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_004: The interface minimises data. The server keeps, under authorisation, the link between the proposal and the people assessed.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_005: Does opening Help make a call-up?
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_006: No. Help only explains the procedure. Actions require their own checks, authorisation and receipt.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_007: Why might an action be disabled?
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_008: Your session has not received explicit permission or the server command is not connected yet.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_009: Guide to managing a job pool call-up. First, choose an authorised staffing need and review the post, location, working hours and deadline. Request the proposal: the server applies the ranking order and the rules; the browser does not choose people. Review the minimised assessments and the job pool and rules versions. Set the deadline and the available channels, and check the staffing need, the proposal and the receipt before confirming. Opening this help does not save or send any data. A disabled action means the required permission is missing or the service is not connected.

ayuda.ayuda_contenido_398: Approve the document, or write the reason and select “Return”.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_399: Make sure the document holder knows exactly what to correct.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_400: Write a short, specific reason, without data about other people.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_401: The decision is recorded with its receipt and the document leaves your inbox.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_403: The document holder will read the reason for the return: state only what must be corrected and do not include third-party data or personal opinions.
ayuda.ayuda_ct_limite_alta: In department requests, identifying yourself with a certificate records who submits or confirms, but it does not electronically sign any document; the corporate identity and signature process are still pending.
ayuda.ayuda_ct_limite_expediente: The receipts for each action are for internal tracking of the case and have no administrative validity on their own.
ayuda.ayuda_ct_limite_llamamiento: What it is for: “Call-up for this case” calls a single person to fill this request; VEC picks the next person on the job pool, in order. In Job pools, “New call-up” is for calling one or more people from a job pool by hand with a shared email, without starting from a case. Steps: 1) press “Call the next person”; 2) record the notice once you have notified them; 3) record the contact with the person, because the reply deadline starts then (the email notice does not start it); 4) record the reply and attach its email; 5) check the reply and confirm it. If they decline or do not reply in time, call the next person. How to save the email as an .eml file: in Outlook (web or new Outlook), open the email, press “More actions” (…) and choose “Download” or “Save as”; in Thunderbird, File › Save as › File; in Gmail, More (⋮) › Download message. If you use classic desktop Outlook, open the email in Outlook on the web or the new Outlook to download it as .eml: .msg files are not accepted. The file can be up to 2 MB. VEC checks it on this computer and does not upload or store its content; the original stays in your mailbox. In “Email reference”, type something that lets you find it, such as the date and subject, without addresses or personal data. If you see “We could not confirm whether it was saved”, press “Try again”: VEC recognises the operation and does not duplicate it. Limits: VEC does not send the email or check that it arrived. Recording the reply does not confirm it; HR confirms it in step 5. VEC does not calculate legal deadlines that HR has not set. Confirming the acceptance is not a signature, an appointment or a start of work.
ayuda.ayuda_ct_limite_nombramiento: The proposal and the manual validation of the decision are not a legal signature, have no administrative effect and do not prove document custody. A confirmed acceptance allows the appointment proposal to be reviewed and recorded. Recording it does not send documents, does not prove delivery and does not sign or appoint the candidate.
ayuda.ayuda_ct_limite_incorporacion: The recorded start of work and the download of the GINPIX record do not prove an official signature, do not send anything and have no administrative effect. The start of work for the year is checked when requested; checking it does not record any start of work.
ayuda.ayuda_ct_limite_seguimiento: The administrative note keeps the stage and status without starting a termination, signature or email, and the administrative closure does not record a termination or send data to Personnel, email or GINPIX. Closure and note: if the result is uncertain, copy the recovery key and save the details before confirming. To recover, load only the original file; loading it does not send any request.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_404: Change the status of an application
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_406: Move to “available from” when an appointment ends, and exclude with the reason given in the Regulation.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_408: On the record, select “Change status”, choose “Available from a date” and enter the end date and the type of appointment. VEC proposes the availability date; confirm or change it.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_409: Apply the unavailability period in art. 9 of the Regulation: five months from the end of the relationship, nine if it was for a workload increase, from date to date.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_410: Have the actual end date of the relationship and its type to hand.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_411: The application is set to “available from” with the confirmed date and its receipt.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_412: HR staff with permission to change statuses.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_413: The Regulation applies this period to the person in all their job pools, but VEC stores the status per application: the change only affects this job pool and the person’s other applications must be reviewed separately. Without a rules catalogue, the date is entered manually.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_414: Exclude with the reason given in the Regulation
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_415: In “Hold, reactivation and exclusion”, select “Exclude” and choose the reason for removal in art. 11; use “Other reason” only if none fits.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_416: Record the reason and its article in the action history.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_417: A supporting document in your custody and a different validating person. The segregation of duties catalogue sets which actions require that second person; exclusion always does.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_418: The exclusion is recorded with the reason, the supporting document and the validation.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_420: Declining with a justified reason (art. 10) is not removal from the pool: record it as “unavailable”. With the rules catalogue, a person who has declined cannot return directly to “available”; they can only be removed.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_421: The “Signature process” shows who signs each draft and in what order. At the pending step you can make a test signature with your signing program (GrxFirma or AutoFirma) or return the draft with a reason; the server verifies and records the signature, but it is a test signature with no administrative effect until the document goes through the corporate e-signature system.
ayuda.ayuda_contenido_422: An electronic signature on a draft, even if made with a personal certificate and verified, has no administrative effect until the document goes through the Diputación’s corporate e-signature system.
ayuda.ayuda_ct_analisis_catalogo: The types of appointment, reasons and budget reservations you can choose come from the rules catalogue, which HR can change without touching the application. If the period exceeds the maximum duration for the type of appointment, the form warns you and only blocks recording when the rule requires it. When the urgency rule is published, HR can declare the case urgent with its reason; urgency is kept, and a correction can declare it but not remove it.
ayuda.ayuda_ct_cuadro_urgencia: The “Urgent” label means that HR declared the case urgent during its review. Deadlines with a duration for urgent cases, such as financial review, use that duration.
ayuda.ayuda_ct_formulario_subsanacion: Correction: include only the administrative information needed. Before sending, download the recovery file and keep it without sharing it; if the result is pending, import it and retry the same action: the server returns the original proof of record without creating another correction.
ayuda.ayuda_b7_resumen: Select candidates in ranking order, set up the common email and issue the call-up.
ayuda.ayuda_b7_seleccion_instruccion: Choose the statuses to include and tick the applications, or select “Select all that match the filter”.
ayuda.ayuda_b7_seleccion_objetivo: Follow the current ranking order of the job pool.
ayuda.ayuda_b7_seleccion_preparacion: People who are working or on hold do not take a turn. Anyone already in service through another application is labelled; if the rules catalogue says to exclude them, they cannot be ticked and are not included in “Select all”.
ayuda.ayuda_b7_seleccion_resultado: The whole job pool is searched with the chosen statuses and up to 100 applications per mailing are selected in ranking order.
ayuda.ayuda_b7_seleccion_limite: To include other applications, review the job pool pages and prepare another mailing.
ayuda.ayuda_b7_configurar_instruccion: Fill in the staffing need, the response deadline and the email text. The subject and text are the same for everyone selected; the placeholders are replaced with each person’s details.
ayuda.ayuda_b7_configurar_objetivo: Communicate the staffing need with the deadline set by HR.
ayuda.ayuda_b7_configurar_preparacion: Enter the deadline set by HR before continuing. If the rules catalogue proposes a deadline, its source (Regulation or example rule) can be checked in “Current rules”.
ayuda.ayuda_b7_configurar_resultado: You move on to the review, without sending any email yet.
ayuda.ayuda_b7_configurar_limite: The application does not assume a legal deadline. Recording the call-up and its proof of record do not prove delivery to the corporate mailbox: check that it was sent and delivered through the approved channel.
ayuda.ayuda_b7_emitir_instruccion: Review the email preview for one person, tick the confirmation and select “Issue call-up”.
ayuda.ayuda_b7_emitir_objetivo: Record a single call-up for exactly the people selected.
ayuda.ayuda_b7_emitir_preparacion: Check the number of people selected and the deadline.
ayuda.ayuda_b7_emitir_resultado: The call-up is issued and awaiting response, with its proof of record; you can copy the reference for follow-up.
ayuda.ayuda_b7_actor: HR staff with permission to issue call-ups.
ayuda.ayuda_extension: Job pools and temporary staff requests offer their own help within each module.
